title: Chevron
description: Draw zigzag bands: yellow (1.0, 0.85, 0.25) and navy (0.08, 0.1, 0.3) stripes that bend into a zigzag. Take the horizontal coordinate x, make a triangle wave abs(fract(x * 2.0) - 0.5), and add twice that wave to y * 3.0. Bands switch on abs(fract(value) - 0.5), with a smoothstep from 0.23 to 0.27 on that quantity. The canvas runs from -1 to 1 in both directions.
hintText: abs(fract(x) - 0.5) makes a triangle wave. Add a scaled copy of it to the y coordinate before taking fract() for the bands, so the stripes bend. Use smoothstep on abs(fract(v) - 0.5) for soft edges.
